description: Unit tests for the OpenCdmAdapter, testing decryption and capability transformation functions, using Google Test framework and mocks.

classes.name: OpenCdmAdapterTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for OpenCdmAdapter unit tests, setting up mock session and GstBuffer objects.

methods.name: ShouldFailToDecryptWhenSessionIsNull
methods.description: Test that decryption fails when the session pointer is null.

methods.name: ShouldDecrypt
methods.description: Test that decryption succeeds when the mock session's addProtectionMeta is called.

methods.name: ShouldTransformCaps
methods.description: Test that the transform caps function returns success when called with null.

methods.name: ShouldFailToDecryptBufferWhenSessionIsNull
methods.description: Test that buffer decryption fails when session pointer is null.

methods.name: ShouldFailToDecryptBufferWhenOperationFails
methods.description: Test that buffer decryption fails when addProtectionMeta returns false.

methods.name: ShouldDecryptBuffer
methods.description: Test that buffer decryption succeeds when addProtectionMeta returns true.
